Working manuscript · July 2026

The Selector
Remains Human

A negative result on compression-based value signals for creative text.

Generic compression does not recover creative appraisal. The strong LitBench boundary is transductive, same-prompt, and preference-labeled; directional MiniLM is stronger than the language-model readout on identical rows.
